dct_description_sm: Georeferenced image of Tsleil-Waututh Nation Burrard Inlet 3 Reserve clipped from [Plan of] Indian Reserves Burrard Inlet

Georeferenced image of Tsleil-Waututh Nation Burrard Inlet 3 Reserve clipped from [Plan of] Indian Reserves Burrard Inlet. Land cover and features described on the map includes "Indian" villages, potato patches, old logging camp, a church, "Indian" houses, and lists of the types of soil, timber, and land cover in each of the Reserves.
